name: Soft-delete, and detach it from everything that syncs to it
description: Soft-delete, and detach it from everything that syncs to it Soft-delete, and detach it from everything that syncs to it. DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/external_data_destinations/{id}/
context:
DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/external_data_destinations/{id}/
Soft-delete, and detach it from everything that syncs to it. Runs already in flight keep their own snapshot of the destination, so deleting one never strands a run part-way through. The next run of each affected table resolves without it.
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this external data destination.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
